voss.prompt: Author a production game UI sprite sheet matching the supplied reference's ornate dark fantasy HUD craft. Visual family: Mara Voss: scratched bronze, dark iron, crimson cloth, tiny skulls and restrained ammunition motifs. Rich layered materials, dimensional beveled fantasy metalwork, crisp readable engraved gold serif lettering, premium finished game UI. Transparent alpha outside each individual piece. Preserve opaque dark leather/stone insets. Front-on orthographic flat usable sprites. NOT a mockup or screenshot. Exactly SEVEN separated elements with generous transparent gutters. Layout FOUR horizontal rows: ROW 1 one centered wider heading plaque, ROW 2 two panels, ROW 3 two buttons, ROW 4 two buttons. All closed ornate frames with safe dark interiors and no ornament over information. Row 1 heading plaque has exact two lines: small "THE APOCALYPSE CAN WAIT." above larger "TAKE A BREATH." Row 2 LEFT location/timer panel: completely EMPTY dark interior, about 4:1 aspect, left 65% clear for two runtime location/countdown lines, right 22% clear for runtime clock. No letters/numbers on this panel. Row 2 RIGHT score panel: about 4:1 aspect, LEFT 55% completely EMPTY dark reserved runtime numeric space, bake exact "SCORE" in RIGHT 30%, with border clearance. Row 3 LEFT button exact "RESUME"; Row 3 RIGHT button exact "BACKPACK & STATS". Row 4 LEFT exact "SETTINGS"; Row 4 RIGHT exact "END EXPEDITION". Buttons same wide 5:1 footprint, fully authored centered lettering inset into themed ornament. Do not bake any numeric values. No icons of keyboard keys, no shortcuts, no extra text. Theme-specific ornament and fabric connects this set to the supplied HUD reference. All seven independent sprites remain apart with transparent margins; no background scene, no surrounding poster frame.
